title: Crash when an issue has an empty body
body:
**Steps to reproduce**
1. Open a new issue with a title but leave the description empty.
2. The Maintainer Copilot workflow runs.

**Expected:** the issue gets triaged.
**Actual:** the workflow fails:

```
File "triage.py", line 151, in fetch_images
    urls = IMG_MD.findall(body)
TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object, got 'NoneType'
```

Version: v0.3.1, Python 3.12 on the ubuntu-24.04 runner.

title: It doesn't work
body: I added it to my repo and nothing happens. Please fix asap.

title: TypeError when someone opens an issue without a description
body: Our bot dies with `TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object` whenever a user submits an issue that only has a title. Happens every time.

title: Typo in README: "recieve"
body: In the Setup section of README.md, "you will recieve a comment" should be "you will receive a comment".
